abstract.t: In an agent system, agents need to discover other agents, tool servers, and skills. Agent Resource Discovery (ARD) defines a manifest listing such resources and a lookup interface over it. This document specifies how a client (such as an agent) initially discovers an ARD manifest. This discovery is performed through the use of DNS Service Binding records, DNS-Based Service Discovery (DNS- SD), HTTP link relations, or well-known URIs. Each mechanism yields a set of manifest URIs. The manifest format, the lookup interface, and the binding of a manifest to its publisher are specified in the companion ARD documents.
